arms.ACTIVE_PLAN_RESIDUAL: single injection of own episode r_PLAN(t2)
arms.GENERIC_HISTORY: non-plan transcript/history residual, rescaled to active norm
arms.NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL: residual from the mandatory 128-token slot containing the exact same first reference action but destroying later plan structure, rescaled to active norm
arms.RANDOM_EQ_NORM: deterministic SHA256 Rademacher direction with active residual dimension and exact active residual norm
arms.SELF_REPLACE: replace selected reset hidden state by an exact captured clone of itself once; plumbing sentinel; must be numerically behavior-equivalent to NO_PATCH within engineering tolerance
arms.SHUFFLED_PLAN: same-plan clause-permutation residual, rescaled to active norm
arms.UNRELATED_PLAN: pre-frozen cyclic different-family plan residual, rescaled to active norm
arms.VISIBLE_TEXT_PLAN: positive ceiling: original 128-token plan slot visible in reset context; no activation intervention
arms.ZERO_ADD: one hook adding exact zero vector; plumbing sentinel, not a primary specificity control

authorization_prerequisites.engineering: Capture-only sanity engineering/result cannot authorize T1. T1 requires a separately engineered persistent-session single-injection runtime and independent executable-readiness review.
authorization_prerequisites.forbidden: Do not execute causal development or confirmation after FAIL_REPLAY_RESIDUAL_SANITY or INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_NATURAL_TRAJECTORIES.
authorization_prerequisites.sanity_scientific_gate: A future canonical ReplayResidual sanity result must be exactly PASS_REPLAY_RESIDUAL_SANITY under SHA 394222b7... before any causal development request.

causal_development.freeze_before_confirmation: selected layer/alpha plus exact implementation/runtime/vector hashes and all development-only aggregates must be content-hashed before the first confirmation model/environment request.
causal_development.population: fixed development indices0..31 only; run only after valid sanity PASS; use all naturally qualified families, no replacement; require >=16/32 qualified else INCONCLUSIVE_T1_DEVELOPMENT_EXPRESSIVITY
causal_development.selection_metric: For each global layer/alpha, compute family later_plan_agreement (LPA) excluding the first post-reset action. Select the point maximizing median across fixed development families of ACTIVE_LPA - max_specificity_control_LPA; tie-break by higher ACTIVE TaskSuccess, then lower alpha, then earlier layer. No per-family point selection.
causal_development.vector_rule: ACTIVE uses alpha * raw r_PLAN(t2). Every nonzero residual/random control is deterministically rescaled to ||r_PLAN||_2 before multiplying by the same alpha. If ||r_PLAN||<=1e-8 the active vector is zero and the family cannot count as a positive comparison.

effect_guards: at least 70% of all20 have d_no_patch>0
at least 65% of all20 have d_specificity>0
ACTIVE valid-action rate is not more than 0.10 below NO_PATCH
confirmation.interpretation: Only causal episode-specific active-plan transport across one real context reset with multi-step effect. Does not yet establish cross-family/model/environment generality or compact/minimal checkpoint.
confirmation.natural_trajectory_gate: require >=16/20 targets with valid own-plan checkpoint/control construction. If fewer, stop INCONCLUSIVE_T1_CONFIRMATION_EXPRESSIVITY. If gate passes, all20 remain in primary denominators; any unqualified/unconstructible family receives zero LPA and nonpositive pairwise differences and cannot count as sign success.
confirmation.operating_point: import exact frozen global layer/alpha from causal development; no layer/site/scale/per-family selection
confirmation.population: exact untouched confirmation n=20, source indices32..51 from population binding; no replacement, no confirmation tuning
tests: Exact one-sided Binomial/sign test n=20 for d_no_patch>0; zero/nonpositive is failure.
Exact one-sided Binomial/sign test n=20 for d_specificity>0; zero/nonpositive is failure.
Holm step-down FWER=0.05 across these two co-primary tests.

high_tier_claim_boundary.candidate_novel_claim: An episode-specific within-trajectory plan residual, injected exactly once after a real context reset and carried only by the persistent model state, causally preserves later plan commitment and task behavior beyond matched next-action, history, unrelated-plan, shuffled-plan and equal-norm random controls.
high_tier_claim_boundary.minimum_paper_ladder: Representation sanity PASS -> untouched causal T1 support -> no-retuning family-disjoint T1R. A persistence/decay or compactness tier and cross-model/environment replication are required for strongest ICLR/NeurIPS framing.

latent_payload_provenance: inherit sanity v1.1 required SHA256 metadata; additionally bind reset_snapshot_sha256, reset_prefix_sha256, active_residual_sha256, injected_vector_sha256, selected_alpha, selected_layer, hook_count, session_id_hash and arm name for every causal rollout.

model_runtime.rebind_policy: technical-only runtime rebind requires separate pre-outcome audit; no model-family/precision change within T1.

natural_checkpoint.planner_executor: same model as sanity; model-own explicit <PLAN> block and uninterrupted trajectory, no expert/oracle plan/action fields
natural_checkpoint.qualification: inherit sanity v1.1 exact plan<=96 token, no reasoning trace, success<=12 actions, interruption with >=2 completed and >=2 remaining; no replacement
natural_checkpoint.reset_boundary: immediately after the second completed post-plan ACTION/OBSERVATION cycle (sanity t2) when >=2 reference actions remain
natural_checkpoint.source_capture_site: last token immediately before the next ACTION: field at t2, residual-stream output of selected transformer block

phase_guards: No T1 causal request before canonical sanity PASS.
No confirmation access before content-hashed development selection.
No replication access before supported primary confirmation.
No threshold relaxation, family replacement/filtering, alternate filler rescue, prompt rescue, or model switch within this lineage.
No partial confirmation inspection to alter protocol.

primary_endpoint.definition: Let reference remaining actions after reset be a1..am (m>=2). For an arm rollout, action1 is deliberately excluded. LPA = (1/(m-1)) * sum_{j=2..m} I[arm action_j equals reference action_j AND pre-action world-state hash equals the uninterrupted reference hash]. If an arm diverges, terminates, or lacks action_j, that and subsequent unmatched positions score 0. Different successful routes therefore do not establish restoration of the original active plan.
primary_endpoint.name: later_plan_agreement_LPA
primary_endpoint.why_first_action_excluded: Immediate next-action copying cannot contribute to the primary endpoint.

attainable_geometry.note: 10/12 is the first attainable count with one-sided p<=0.025; therefore both co-primary tests can pass Holm when each has >=10/12 positive family differences.

replication_reserve.decision_rule: REPLICATED_REPLAY_RESIDUAL_T1 iff natural-trajectory gate passes, BOTH exact sign tests pass Holm FWER .05, and ALL replication effect/task-success/valid-action guards pass. Otherwise, if gate passed and execution is valid, label NOT_REPLICATED_REPLAY_RESIDUAL_T1. Technical/provenance violations are TECHNICAL_INVALID_T1R.
effect_guards: at least 9/12 families have d_no_patch>0 (mechanical integer realization of primary >=70% guard)
at least 8/12 families have d_specificity>0 (mechanical integer realization of primary >=65% guard)
ACTIVE TaskSuccess - NO_PATCH TaskSuccess >= 0.15 across all12
ACTIVE valid-action rate is not more than 0.10 below NO_PATCH across all12
replication_reserve.natural_trajectory_gate: Require >=10/12 fixed reserve families to yield a valid model-own plan checkpoint and all mandatory control constructions under the exact imported primary protocol. If fewer than 10/12 are valid, stop INCONCLUSIVE_T1R_EXPRESSIVITY. If the gate passes, ALL 12 fixed families remain in every primary replication denominator; any invalid/unconstructible family receives LPA=0 for ACTIVE and nonpositive d_no_patch/d_specificity, cannot count as a sign success, and is never replaced.
replication_reserve.no_rescue: T1R cannot rescue a null/invalid primary confirmation. A null T1R cannot be rescued by retuning layer/site/alpha, changing thresholds, dropping/replacing families, switching model/prompt/environment, inspecting a new reserve, or relaxing multiplicity/effect guards. Any later larger replication must be separately frozen before T1R outcome access and reported as a distinct evidence family.
replication_reserve.population: exact n=12 source indices52..63, untouched until valid SUPPORTED_REPLAY_RESIDUAL_T1
replication_reserve.power_note: n=12 is a robustness replication with limited power: under a true per-family positive-difference probability of 0.80, P[X>=10] is about 0.558. Therefore a failure is evidence against exact replication but does not by itself establish absence of the mechanism outside this preregistered reserve; the primary n=20 remains the main causal confirmation.
replication_reserve.role: family-disjoint T1R robustness; cannot rescue a null primary confirmation
replication_reserve.rule: import exact confirmation layer/alpha, vector normalization, runtime, endpoints, thresholds and arm definitions with no retuning/replacement
tests: Exact one-sided Binomial/sign test n=12 for d_no_patch>0; zero/nonpositive is failure.
Exact one-sided Binomial/sign test n=12 for d_specificity>0; zero/nonpositive is failure.
Holm step-down FWER=0.05 across these two co-primary replication tests.

reset_and_session_contract.external_state: clone the exact environment snapshot at reset; world-state hash, current observation, admissible-action set, task instruction and reset serialization must match across all causal arms
reset_and_session_contract.failure_label: INVALID_REPEATED_INTERVENTION if hook_count !=1, reset prefix is recomputed, KV session is restarted, or a vector is injected after the reset-prefix forward.
reset_and_session_contract.persistence: all later generated action tokens and appended environment observations continue through the SAME KV/session. Never rebuild the reset prefix and never re-inject/recompute the intervention.
reset_and_session_contract.reset_context: task instruction + current reset observation + current admissible actions + ACTION: field; no pre-reset plan text, no old dialogue/history, no expert state
reset_and_session_contract.single_injection: exactly one hook application on the reset-prefix forward at the selected layer and last token immediately before ACTION:. Hook counter MUST equal 1, then hook is removed permanently.

secondary_endpoints.first_action_match: reported descriptively only and cannot rescue LPA
secondary_endpoints.task_success: binary environment success within <=12 post-reset environment actions
secondary_endpoints.valid_action_rate: fraction of generated actions accepted by the environment
secondary_endpoints.visible_text_ceiling: LPA and TaskSuccess under VISIBLE_TEXT_PLAN, descriptive positive ceiling

supersedes.reason: Pre-outcome completion of explicit T1R decision rule required by independent review; no primary T1 or population change.
